name: Specific

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Fee is really a $25/mo floor: 'includes $25 usage credits'. Postgres CU, workflows and object storage draw on the same credits. Custom domains need a paid plan.

plans.name: Scale
plans.note: $299/mo floor with $299 usage credits; 'No limits on compute or storage'; SSO membership management.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 5 projects; 'Limited compute per service 0.25 vCPU / 512 MB memory'; 512 MB database storage; 1 GB file storage; no custom domains; 1-day retention. Whether free compute is unmetered/free of charge is implied ($0/month) but not stated as hours.

caveats: Services (web/workers/cron) priced separately from managed Postgres, workflows and object storage; those are not interchangeable compute units. Pro $25 and Scale $299 are usage-credit fees.
Free service is only 0.25 vCPU/512 MB, not general 4/8. Raw usage card excludes database and workflow charges.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Referral: $100 usage credits per referred paid org, max 10 rewards, apply to metered usage only (not plan fees), expire after 12 months (ToS 2026-09-18). Startup credits up to $10,000 on request (funded startups only). Neither should be modelled as general free credit.

Other metered products not in the card: Postgres $0.15/CU-h ($0.30 with real-time sync), $0.4/GB-month storage, $0.10/GB egress; Workflows $0.075/1000 actions, $0.07/GB-h active storage, $0.0016/GB-h retained; Object storage $0.03/GB-month, $0.005/1000 PUT, $0.0005/1000 GET, free egress.
Pricing may change with 30 days notice, effective next monthly Subscription Period; auto-charged monthly.
Spectest test environments are full Linux VMs (docs); no public pricing found, not modelled.

fleet.tiers: Free: 5 projects with limited compute per service. Pro: unlimited projects and autoscaling; Scale advertises no compute/storage limits.
fleet.notes: Projects are not instances and 0.25 vCPU free service size is not aggregate vCPU quota. No public new-account concurrency/vCPU/GPU pool, verification or approval time established.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

ingress_rules.quote: Omitting `public` (or `public = false`) keeps the endpoint internal-only.
ingress_rules.note: Per-endpoint public (HTTPS *.spcf.app or custom domain) vs internal-only on a private network (private_url reachable only by other services); multiple endpoints per service each independently public/internal. No IP allowlist or auth-gated URLs documented.

secret_proxy.quote: Secrets are stored securely, never logged, and injected into services as environment variables at runtime.
secret_proxy.note: Secret store -> plaintext env vars in the service; no credential-injecting proxy.

volume_attach.quote: **In production**: each volume is backed by a persistent disk, and `path` resolves to `/volumes/{name}` inside the container.
volume_attach.note: Declared per service (volume "name" {}), multiple per service, persist across deploys/restarts; $0.15/GB-month on card.
